description: Show the balance of the account that owns ABLITERATEDLLM_API_KEY: credit available for new requests, credit held by running requests, whether it is a trial account, and what is left of the key's daily, monthly and lifetime spend caps (null: no cap). Amounts are USD decimal strings. Spends nothing, so it is also the way to check that the key works.
name: get_balance
title: Get AbliteratedLLM balance
